verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations represent each B2B customer with its own connections, members and branding, plus federated login flows per business. The B2B offering lets enterprise clients configure SSO themselves, verify domain ownership, and sync directories via SCIM. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of just-in-time provisioning on first SSO login (SCIM is a different directory-sync mechanism), in-depth docs on how domain verification works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
